title: Weekly marketing intelligence
summary: Illustrative structure for decision-useful Mellanni guidance and broader ecommerce signals.

actions.title: Keep the next growth test inside the private margin guardrail
actions.externalSignal: Operators are increasingly evaluating channel growth on contribution rather than attributed revenue alone.

memory.comparison: The bounded memory search found no record specific enough to change this illustrative decision.
memory.decisionImpact: Use the fresh private Mellanni evidence as the decision basis.

mellanniEvidence.entityScope: Illustrative portfolio / ASIN B012345678 / campaign SP-BRAND-042
mellanniEvidence.conclusion: Synthetic portfolio evidence shows $1.25M in sales and 31% contribution efficiency over the trailing 28 days, supporting an efficiency-first test.

privateDecision.baseline: Illustrative contribution efficiency is 31 percent over the trailing 28 days.
privateDecision.guidance: Run one bounded growth test inside the measured portfolio guardrail.
privateDecision.successCondition: Promote the test if contribution efficiency improves to 26 percent or better while qualified demand stays within 5 percent of baseline.
privateDecision.stopCondition: Stop if contribution efficiency reaches 34 percent or inventory coverage falls below 21 days.

actions.guidance: Run one bounded channel test while keeping contribution efficiency at 31% or better.
actions.successCondition: Promote if contribution efficiency reaches 26% or better while qualified demand stays within 5% of baseline.
actions.stopCondition: Stop if contribution efficiency reaches 34% or inventory coverage falls below 21 days.
limitations: All checked-in metrics and identifiers are synthetic.

skillReferences.applicability: Choose the first-party source that owns each required business metric.
skillReferences.intendedNextOperation: Route the approved test readback to the correct Mellanni provider.

signals.title: Creator commerce is becoming a discovery layer
signals.externalSignal: Creator-led commerce is expanding beyond direct conversion into product discovery and later demand capture.

memory.comparison: The external signal is consistent with the selected historical record on separating discovery from measured conversion.
memory.decisionImpact: Keep the signal in the digest, but do not call it a Mellanni result without a bounded validation test.

signals.whyItMatters: This may affect creative, attribution, and demand-capture choices across ecommerce channels, not only Amazon.
signals.nextValidation: Define a small creator-content holdout and query branded demand plus downstream conversion before promoting this signal to an Action.

skillReferences.applicability: Check whether external discovery coincides with measurable branded or category search movement.
skillReferences.intendedNextOperation: Run bounded keyword discovery and compare it with first-party demand evidence.
